game_title: Off By One Fixer – Waterfall Pool Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Waterfall Pool, a pool below a waterfall: the herbalist must handle shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Off By One Fixer: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one.
theme: Mystic Forest – Waterfall Pool: a pool below a waterfall
core_gameplay_loop: In Waterfall Pool, repeat each round: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one. Each round, shadow wolves strike the seed vault, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the fixes value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the seed vault from shadow wolves in Waterfall Pool: keep the fixes meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: fixes drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Off By One Fixer
